slice: RPP-5js selected MLINESTYLE body source/live evidence
scope: A bounded AC1027 ASCII/binary DXF proof joining selected MLINESTYLE source bodies, captured raw baselines, unique live typed models and their selected ACAD_MLINESTYLE dictionary entries. It is proof-only and grants no export, geometry or support authority.

contract.sourceBinding: Requires the accepted same-read whole-source and legacy identity captures, matching AC1027 encoding/context, exact source physical spans and group/value agreement between each selected MLINESTYLE record and its immutable raw baseline. The selected root/child dictionary proofs are included in the logical work charge.
contract.liveBinding: Joins each selected dictionary entry to exactly one identity record, immutable captured raw body, current raw object and unique live DRW_MLineStyle. It compares common state, typed fields and parser-private completion state; mutation, raw tampering, hidden-state reset, count/list changes and oversized mutable payloads refuse. Restoring the same adapter succeeds.
contract.workAccounting: Preflights mutable text and raw payload sizes, bounds group/vector/app-data counts, charges variable-byte and item work plus captured-source scans and nested proof costs before the source/body equality and decode passes.
contract.compatibility: Adds a private dx_iface proof method and focused selector only. No installed header, public callback, virtual, or object layout changes.
contract.limits: Only the selected AC1027 authored profile in ASCII and binary DXF is covered. This does not bind MLINE consumers or other graph carriers, qualify output, enable edits/export, prove consumed geometry, or establish native semantics. No support claim is promoted.

controls.inputGeneration: Test source is produced from the locally authored in-test DXF text, encoded to ASCII and binary under temporary scratch paths, and removed by test cleanup. No DWG/DXF fixture was added to Git.
